# Cloudflare Pages response headers (generated by src/build55.py from src/headers.txt; edit that file).
# Same approach as coreymcdaniel.com: strict CSP (scripts by hash), HSTS, no sniffing, no framing.
# connect-src allows any https: origin because the optional AI helper calls the provider the visitor picks
# and checks that suggested sites answer.

https://:project.pages.dev/*
  X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow
https://*.:project.pages.dev/*
  X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow

/*
  Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate, no-transform
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
  Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()
  Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin
  Content-Security-Policy: __CSP__

# the service worker must always be re-checked so updates roll out
/sw.js
  ! Cache-Control
  Cache-Control: no-cache, no-transform

/manifest.webmanifest
  Content-Type: application/manifest+json

/icons/*
  ! Cache-Control
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=604800, no-transform
